articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process and generate across code, video, and audio modalities in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in complex multi-step reasoning benchmarks and reduces hallucination rates by roughly 40% compared to GPT-5's initial release. Enterprise API pricing was cut by 30%, signaling OpenAI's push to maintain dominance against surging competition from Google and Anthropic.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a new architecture it calls 'recursive self-verification,' enabling the model to iteratively check and refine its own reasoning chains during inference. On newly released ScienceBench-2026 evaluations, the model outperformed all competitors in mathematical theorem proving and molecular property prediction. Researchers highlight the model's ability to propose novel hypotheses that were subsequently validated in wet-lab experiments in materials science.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Real-Time Tool Use and Persistent Memory Across Sessions
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude 4, which features a persistent memory layer allowing the model to retain user context and preferences across sessions without re-prompting. The release also includes a dramatically improved agentic tool-use framework that enables Claude to autonomously orchestrate multi-step workflows across APIs, file systems, and databases. Early enterprise adopters report up to 60% reductions in workflow automation development time compared to previous agent frameworks.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Autonomous Construction Site Capabilities
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated the third generation of its electric Atlas humanoid robot performing autonomous construction tasks including bricklaying, rebar placement, and debris clearing on a live job site. The robot uses an on-board vision-language model for real-time task planning and can adapt to unexpected obstacles without human intervention. The company announced commercial pilot programs with three major construction firms, targeting a 2027 general availability date.

articles.title: Figure AI's Humanoid Robot Begins Warehouse Shifts Alongside Human Workers at Amazon Facilities
articles.summary: Figure AI's Figure 03 humanoid robot has started performing full 8-hour shifts at select Amazon fulfillment centers, handling pick-and-place, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks. The robots leverage a foundation world model trained on millions of hours of manipulation data, enabling generalization to novel package geometries without retraining. Amazon confirmed plans to expand deployment to 20 additional warehouses by Q2 2027, reigniting debate around automation and workforce displacement.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Chips for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has started high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors, marking a major milestone in semiconductor fabrication. The node delivers a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over the 2nm node, with first customer shipments going to Nvidia and Apple. Industry analysts say the node is critical for enabling the next generation of AI training accelerators that will support models with tens of trillions of parameters.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Photorealistic 3D World Generation Model for AR and VR Applications
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced 'WorldGen-3D,' a diffusion-based model that generates fully navigable, photorealistic 3D environments from text or image prompts in under 60 seconds. The model produces geometry, textures, and physically plausible lighting suitable for direct import into Unreal Engine and Unity. The release is seen as a strategic move to accelerate content creation for Meta's Quest headset ecosystem and lower barriers for independent VR developers.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with Bidirectional Stimulation
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which features 4,096 electrodes and bidirectional stimulation capability, enabling both reading and writing of neural signals. The device aims to restore not just motor control but also tactile feedback for paralysis patients, a significant leap from the read-only first-generation device. The approval comes after 18 months of successful primate trials showing stable performance over extended periods with minimal electrode degradation.
